# QS Quacquarelli Symonds

> > QS is the world's leading provider of higher education analytics, university rankings, student recruitment solutions, and institutional performance data for universities worldwide.

QS operates globally with offices in locations including London, Kuala Lumpur, Mumbai, Bucharest, and Abuja, serving universities through data-driven insights, the QS World University Rankings, international student surveys, and strategic recruitment services. The organization focuses on advancing higher education through integrated analytics, sustainability benchmarking aligned with UN Sustainable Development Goals, and connecting institutions with prospective students globally.

## Key Topics

- QS World University Rankings
- Higher education analytics
- International student recruitment
- University benchmarking
- Institutional performance
- UN Sustainable Development Goals
- ESG in higher education
